summary: Runs Python callback methods when monitored operators cook, are deleted, change flags, are rewired, renamed, moved, or have component child/extension changes.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable monitoring of the referenced operators

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose script execution context for callbacks

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator path used when Execute From is Specified Operator

key_params.name: op
key_params.note: Operators whose state changes trigger callback methods

key_params.name: precook
key_params.note: Run onPreCook() before the monitored operator cooks

key_params.name: postcook
key_params.note: Run onPostCook() after the monitored operator cooks

key_params.name: opdelete
key_params.note: Run onDestroy() when the operator is deleted

key_params.name: flagchange
key_params.note: Run onFlagChange() when a monitored flag changes

key_params.name: wirechange
key_params.note: Run onWireChange() when inputs are rewired

key_params.name: namechange
key_params.note: Run onNameChange() when the operator name changes

key_params.name: pathchange
key_params.note: Run onPathChange() when the operator path changes

key_params.name: uichange
key_params.note: Run onUIChange() when the operator is moved or resized in the network editor

key_params.name: numchildrenchange
key_params.note: Run onNumChildrenChange() when a component's child count changes

key_params.name: childrename
key_params.note: Run onChildRename() when a child operator is renamed

key_params.name: currentchildchange
key_params.note: Run onCurrentChildChange() when a component current child changes

key_params.name: extensionchange
key_params.note: Run onExtensionChange() when an extension changes

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: External callback source file path

key_params.name: syncfile
key_params.note: Synchronize DAT contents with the external file

key_params.name: loadonstart
key_params.note: Reload the file when the project starts

key_params.name: loadonstartpulse
key_params.note: Reload the file immediately

key_params.name: write
key_params.note: Write DAT contents to disk when the project is saved

key_params.name: writepulse
key_params.note: Write DAT contents to disk immediately

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: edit
key_params.note: Open the callback DAT text in an external editor

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language selection

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Pre-cook and post-cook callbacks can run very frequently and can create recursive or expensive behavior if they mutate watched networks.
Each enabled condition has a matching callback method; toggling a condition on without a safe method body can still execute template code.
Component-only triggers such as child rename and current child change do not apply meaningfully to every operator family.
Sync to File writes DAT edits to disk immediately and can create or overwrite callback files.
key_concepts: Runs callbacks when watched operators cook, delete, change flags, rewire, rename, move path, or change UI state.
The OP parameter selects the operator or operator pattern being monitored.
Child-count, current-child, and extension callbacks cover component hierarchy and extension changes.
Execute-location and file-sync controls mirror other callback DAT script surfaces.
